Batch of UpSet plots across several variables

Source: R/plots.R
plot_upset_batch.Rd

Runs plot_upset() once per entry of vars, restricting df to the distinct (var, Compare) combinations beforehand (via select_unique()) so each plot only sees the columns it needs, and titles each plot "<var> overlap by <Compare>".

Usage

plot_upset_batch(
  df,
  vars,
  n_intersections = 20,
  Compare = "Condition",
  labels = "abs",
  lab.size = 2
)

Arguments

df

A pep_all-shaped data frame.

vars

Character vector of column names to plot overlap for, e.g. c("Peptide", "Sequence", "Accession").

n_intersections

Maximum number of intersections to display per plot.

Compare

Name (string) of the column defining the groups compared.

labels

Forwarded to plot_upset() ("abs", "perc", or other).

lab.size

Forwarded to plot_upset().

Value

A named list of ggplot2/ggupset objects, one per entry of vars, named "<var>_by_<Compare>".

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_upset_batch(pep_all, c("Peptide", "Sequence", "Accession"), Compare = "Condition")
} # }
